analysis.discrimination_note: The harder tasks exposed six criterion failures, but aggregate scores were identical and five failures were the same non-core material-extension pattern.

decision.conclusion: Keep 0.1.0 unchanged. The discriminative tasks exposed one isolated ours core failure and five non-core failures, with no mechanism-level gate and no arm-level score difference.

limitations: Six synthetic single-turn text-planning tasks, one model, one reasoning effort, and three repetitions per arm.
The reviewer was model-assisted, knew the frozen protocol and skills, and was blind only to the randomized arm mapping.
No implicit routing, image generation, rendered image quality, file writeback, editor integration, or real-reader comprehension was tested.
Equal aggregate scores do not establish relative benefit or a general product ranking.
Raw Promptfoo artifacts remain git-ignored; the public report embeds synthetic outputs and hashes but a fresh clone cannot independently recreate provider events.
